Current application

210 pages, 1542 widgets, 7 data views; graph and metadata retrieval available.

Mode: rules. Configured model: none at none. Configuration alone does not prove inference.

Since server restart: 0 model requests, 0 responses, 0 accepted slot responses, 0 errors. Individual turn traces identify rules/model/fallback.

UCI: 1,007,913 eligible rows, 59,458 exclusions, 2009-12-01 through 2011-12-09, GBP. Separate synthetic DuckDB remains available.

Connector: Baserow read-only UCI table/field-schema snapshot. Active dataset came from the local official workbook. Live external platform verification: not executed. No external page/widget/navigation control; no write-back or arbitrary database semantic model.

Measured KPIs
